purpose.summary: Capture historical native position metadata in fixed-size batches and construct the catalogue outside native locks without replacing upstream Chronik.
scope: Direct child of the published signed PR65 head 7cb90b9; do not assume the parent merged or its integration hold resolved.
Capture at most 64 position rows per native-lock hold; build, allocate, remove and discard catalogue containers outside native locks.
Serialize concurrent refreshes only after releasing native and metadata locks; recheck completed state and retain the existing warm fast path.
Reject native health, tip and generation drift before each batch and publication; retain separate mutable-position and disk authentication checks.
Preserve all eight inherited bridge/disk case bodies and 166 assertions; add six independent leaf cases with 50 assertions, under the unchanged 60-second process deadline.
Preserve every inherited group, count, relative order, environment, cleanup and report rule. CI retains ten repetitions and all existing 5000-block upstream ALP/plugin reconstruction clients.
exclusions: No mainnet/testnet admission, activation, consensus change or default-ON service.
No upstream indexer, ALP algorithm, plugin engine, schema, dependency-lock or daemon-client change.
No private reports/history/operator data, server access, deployment, cutover, release, desktop integration or proof promotion.

scenarios.command: Run the six independent position-catalogue leaf processes plus all inherited matrix groups with ten CI repetitions; retain every existing daemon client including long_history_service.py.
expected_results: The six new cases pass 12, 8, 7, 7, 5, 11 assertions; cross-batch and queued-reader native-lock probes succeed without timing-only acceptance.
All eight inherited bridge/disk cases pass 166 assertions with unchanged bodies, selection and process law.
The unchanged upstream 5000-block ALP/plugin cold reconstruction, same-index process reopen and native advance to 5001 continue to pass.
failure_conditions: Changed native authentication, incomplete or stale catalogue publication, lock retention, wrong names/counts, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, source/build drift, unstable output or failed cleanup.

limitations: Initial total catalogue work and memory remain O(height); bounded metadata rows are not a wall-clock or production resource guarantee.
Continuous native progress can invalidate staging; no automatic retry or continuous-ingress admission is claimed.
Mutable storage position identity is separate from active-chain generation and remains independently checked.
Only unpruned local regtest is admitted; compiled-out, default-OFF, mempool, payload, live-window and deep-reorg contracts do not change.
The published PR65 parent remains a review dependency; do not integrate through or waive its unresolved historical local timeout hold.
No governed complete matrix or CI result for this change is claimed by this record. System dependencies remain unlocked; public binary provenance and mainnet-history readiness remain open.
counterevidence: The parent lot retained two local normal-matrix capture-and-query-controls timeouts at repetition 2 under the unchanged 60-second deadline. Its passing Ubuntu CI and later diagnostics do not establish the exact local cause or retire those refusals.
Earlier startup/stop-reopen timeouts and upstream dependency alerts remain open.
No operator history, server comparison, deployment, activation or cutover is exercised.
